vapid.party - Cloudflare Web Push + XMTP-aware relay

Base URL:
- https://vapid.party

Production status:
- The current Worker and D1 migration 0002 are deployed.
- Public XMTP VAPID, registration, and logical-delete routes are live.
- Official-envelope ingest is live and requires a bearer token.
- A real-Chrome D1 -> Queue -> FCM -> Converge service-worker test passed with
  two logical inboxes sharing one endpoint, welcome/group delivery, suppression,
  deletion, privacy, and cleanup checks.
- A genuine XMTP v3 test passed through the production relay using the official
  notification server and temporary PostgreSQL, including installation welcome,
  inbound conversation delivery, three HMAC epochs, and own-message suppression.
- No always-on XMTP listener/PostgreSQL is deployed, so automatic production
  delivery is not continuously available.

OpenAPI:
- /openapi.yaml

Response shape:
- Success: `{ "success": true, "data": ... }`
- Error: `{ "success": false, "error": "...", "code": "...", "details": ...? }`
- Validation errors use HTTP 422 and include `details.issues[]`.

Public Converge XMTP routes:
- GET /api/xmtp/vapid-public-key
- POST /api/xmtp/subscriptions
- DELETE /api/xmtp/subscriptions

Converge route auth:
- No client secret and no baked client API key.
- Do not send `X-API-Key`.

Primary Converge registration body:
- `version` is 1 and `app.id` is `converge.cv`.
- `identity` contains `inboxId`, `installationId`, and optional `address`.
- `subscription` is a standard browser Web Push subscription.
- `xmtp.env` is `production`.
- `xmtp.topics` contains canonical `/xmtp/mls/1/g-<hex>/proto` group topics
  with one or more `{ epoch, key }` HMAC entries, plus the canonical
  `/xmtp/mls/1/w-<hex>/proto` welcome topic with an empty HMAC array.
- `notification.inboxHandle` is an opaque base64url-style local routing token,
  never a display name or raw inbox id.
- `preferences.minimalPayloadOnly` is true.
- `preferences.plaintextPreview` is false.
- `registeredAt` is an ISO timestamp.
- The legacy flattened registration body remains accepted for old clients.

DELETE body:
- Current clients send `{ version, app, endpoint, identity, deletedAt }`.
- The flattened `{ endpoint, inboxId, installationId }` body remains accepted.
- Delete removes the identity's topics and HMAC keys.
- A physical endpoint remains while another active logical inbox shares it; the
  last logical delete removes endpoint, p256dh, and auth data.

Internal official XMTP delivery:
- POST /api/internal/xmtp/deliveries
- Requires `Authorization: Bearer <INTERNAL_INGEST_TOKEN>`.
- `X-Internal-Token` and `/api/internal/xmtp/envelopes` are compatibility aliases.
- Accepts the official example-notification-server-go HTTP SendRequest JSON.
- Matches `installation.id` plus `subscription.topic`.
- Honors `message_context.should_push` and deduplicates `idempotency_key`.
- Returns HTTP 200 because the official adapter retries any other status.
- Discards the encrypted `message.message` bytes without storing or forwarding them.

XMTP Web Push payload:
- `type`: `xmtp.new_message`
- `inboxHandle`: opaque local routing token
- No title, body, URL, conversation id, sender, preview, or message content.
- Converge's service worker owns visible notification copy and navigation.

Privacy rule:
- vapid.party never stores, forwards, or previews plaintext XMTP message text,
  sender names, decrypted content, attachment URLs, or previews.
- Converge opens and syncs/decrypts XMTP locally.

Generic Web Push route auth:
- App management endpoints use wallet bearer auth.
- Generic push endpoints use `X-API-Key`.
- The reserved Converge app's generic routes fail closed unless the
  `CONVERGE_API_KEY` Worker secret is configured.
- The former source-visible Converge generic API key is rejected in production.
